subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR require live owner-session delivery proof before merge, or may maintainers accept source-level tests and CI for the Telegram-visible delivery path?
rationale: The code shape is narrow, but the affected behavior is visible message delivery across session isolation and the PR itself acknowledges that live Telegram/Mantis proof is pending.

options.title: Require live delivery proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept source-only delivery risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge with source and regression-test evidence only, while owning the risk that real transport/session delivery still misroutes or drops completion messages.

options.title: Pause for a broader delivery contract
options.body: If maintainers want one canonical task-completion wake contract across background-task, ACP, exec, and subagent paths, pause this PR and fold the useful tests into that design.

recommendation.title: Require live delivery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently merged adjacent heartbeat delivery cleanup and are a good owner for deciding whether the remaining delivery proof is sufficient.
